# Micah 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-I-said, "Hear, please, heads-of Jacob and-rulers-of the-house-of Israel! Is-it-not for-you to-know justice?

**2** [You]-who-hate good and-love evil, who-tear the-skin from-upon-them and-their-flesh from-upon their-bones,

**3** And-who eat the-flesh-of my-people, and-their-skin from-upon-them they-strip, and-their-bones they-break, and-they-spread-[them]-out as-[meat]-in-a-pot and-as-flesh in-the-midst-of a-caldron."

**4** Then they-will-cry-out to YHWH, but-He-will-not answer-them; and-He-will-hide His-face from-them at-that time, as they-made-evil their-deeds.

**5** Thus says YHWH concerning the-prophets who-lead-astray my-people, who-bite with-their-teeth and-cry, "Peace!" and-whoever does-not-put [something]-into their-mouth, they-declare war against-him:

**6** "Therefore night [will be]-to-you without vision, and-darkness-to-you without divination; and-the-sun will-set upon the-prophets, and-the-day will-be-dark upon-them.

**7** And-the-seers will-be-ashamed, and-the-diviners will-be-disgraced, and-they-will-cover the-upper-lip, all-of-them, for-there-is no answer-of God."

**8** But truly I am-full-of power — the-Spirit-of YHWH — and-justice and-might, to-declare to-Jacob his-transgression and-to-Israel his-sin.

**9** Hear this, please, heads-of the-house-of Jacob and-rulers-of the-house-of Israel, who-abhor justice and-twist all uprightness,

**10** Who-build Zion with-blood and-Jerusalem with-iniquity.

**11** Her-heads judge for-a-bribe, and-her-priests teach for-a-price, and-her-prophets divine for-money, and-upon YHWH they-lean, saying, "Is-not YHWH in-our-midst? Evil will-not-come upon-us!"

**12** Therefore because-of-you Zion [as]-a-field will-be-plowed, and-Jerusalem [will-become]-heaps-of-ruins, and-the-mountain-of the-house [will-be] high-places-of [a]-forest.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **3:2-3**: Cannibalism imagery — the leaders 'eat' their people. The metaphor is economic: exploitation so thorough it consumes the vulnerable completely. Skin, flesh, bones — nothing is left.

- **3:8**: Ve-ulam anokhi maleti koach — 'But truly I am full of power.' Micah's self-authentication against the false prophets. The Spirit of YHWH is the source; justice and might are the content.

- **3:12**: Tzion sadeh techeresh — 'Zion as a field will be plowed.' This exact verse was quoted a century later to save Jeremiah's life (Jer 26:18). The most devastating prophecy in Micah — the Temple mount becomes wilderness.

— EMET
